generic.label: Generic Agent Skills client
generic.explicit_invocation: Use the skill-analyzer skill. Execute the requested Gateway command and load only the routed specialist skills and references needed.
generic.notes: Portable fallback. Paste the invocation envelope or prompt; slash syntax is only text unless the host registers it.

codex.label: OpenAI Codex
codex.explicit_invocation: Use the skill-analyzer skill and execute the requested Gateway command. Read GATEWAY.md and gateway/registry.json for routing.
codex.notes: Codex discovers skills from supported locations and selects them from descriptions or explicit skill naming. Do not treat /analyzer as a built-in Codex command.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.explicit_invocation: /skill-analyzer followed by the requested Gateway command and target.
claude-code.notes: A skill can be invoked by /skill-name. The Gateway command is an argument convention, not a separately registered Claude command.

github-copilot-vscode.label: GitHub Copilot in VS Code
github-copilot-vscode.explicit_invocation: Select /skill-analyzer from the skill picker when surfaced, then state the Gateway command; otherwise prompt: Use the /skill-analyzer skill to audit ...
github-copilot-vscode.notes: Availability depends on Copilot product surface, IDE version, policy, and whether the workspace skill is discovered.

github-copilot-cli.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
github-copilot-cli.explicit_invocation: Use the /skill-analyzer skill to execute the Gateway command. Check discovered skills with the host's /skills commands.
github-copilot-cli.notes: Use the skill's name in the prompt; management and invocation commands vary by CLI version.

github-copilot-app.label: GitHub Copilot app
github-copilot-app.explicit_invocation: Ask Copilot to use the skill-analyzer skill and provide the Gateway command. Confirm the skill is available in that session.
github-copilot-app.notes: Do not assume repository skill availability or a custom slash command merely because the app supports built-in slash commands.

gemini-cli.label: Gemini CLI
gemini-cli.explicit_invocation: /analyzer:audit <target> when installed as the SKILL ANALYZER extension; otherwise ask Gemini CLI to use skill-analyzer and run audit.
gemini-cli.notes: The extension ships custom prompt commands under commands/analyzer/*.toml and skills under skills/. Use /skills list to verify discovered skills.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.explicit_invocation: /skill-analyzer followed by the Gateway command, or attach the skill through the @ picker.
cursor.notes: Cursor exposes discovered skills through the slash picker and can attach a skill with @. Cloud Agent access to local skills depends on sync and project scope.

vscode.label: Visual Studio Code
vscode.explicit_invocation: Use the skill picker or /skill-analyzer if the active agent harness exposes it; otherwise name the skill directly in the prompt.
vscode.notes: VS Code is a host shell; discovery and invocation depend on the selected agent integration.

openai-api.label: OpenAI Responses API / Agents SDK
project_skill_paths: configured skill bundle or capability directory
openai-api.explicit_invocation: Attach or expose the SKILL ANALYZER skill bundle, then instruct the model: Use the skill-analyzer skill and execute command audit.
openai-api.notes: Skill discovery depends on configured shell capability directories or attached skill bundles. Tools and execution are wired by the host application.

chatgpt-plugin.label: ChatGPT plugin/app package
chatgpt-plugin.explicit_invocation: Open/select the SKILL ANALYZER app or plugin and submit the Gateway command with its target.
chatgpt-plugin.notes: The OpenAI package manifest is distinct from generic Agent Skills exports. App availability and tool bindings remain host-managed.

remote-gateway.label: Hosted SKILL ANALYZER Gateway
project_skill_paths: Remote service URL; no local skill installation required
remote-gateway.explicit_invocation: Connect an MCP client to the configured /mcp endpoint, or POST to /v1/invoke with an OAuth bearer token.
remote-gateway.notes: Requires a deployed service URL and an access token from its configured OAuth 2.1/OIDC issuer. One public origin serves both Remote MCP and JSON HTTP API.
